propositions: Test `test_a_rekeyed_issue_resolves_by_id_and_records_what_the_stale_key_returns` fails ~1 in 26 runs when the harness-generated project key ends in 'Z', because the derivation logic (replace final char with 'Z') produces a self-collision.
Project key derivation replaces the final character with literal 'Z', but when the original key already ends in 'Z', the derived key is identical to the source, violating the setup assertion.

The fix must derive a target key that cannot collide with any key the harness can generate, proven by a unit test covering all 26 possible final letters, and must retain the collision-detection setup assertion.
The derived project key must satisfy Jira's constraints (uppercase letters only, length 2-10, same length as source) asserted rather than assumed.
